notes.title: Noir Total at Play Sorbonne Université !
notes.content: [h2]Meet the team ![/h2][p][/p][p]Be t[b]he first to try the latest builds[/b] and [b]meet the team[/b] behind [b]Noir Total: Deadly Party[/b] on Saturday, September 20, 2025, at Sorbonne University ([url="https://maps.app.goo.gl/3ZGanXRvKPrvteai6"]4 Place Jussieu, Paris[/url]) during the [url="https://playsorbonne.fr/festival/"]Play Sorbonne Festival[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Festival[/h2][p]On Saturday, September 20, the festival will gather 40 independent teams showcasing their creative projects![/p][p]You’ll be able to play, enjoy some food, and discover the next French gems in indie video games and board games![/p][p]A big crowd is expected, so don’t forget to book your free ticket before the 20th through this link: [url="https://www.helloasso.com/associations/play-sorbonne-universite/evenements/play-sorbonne-festival-2025-3" style="button"]FREE REGISTRATION[/url][/p][p][u]Many thanks to the festival’s amazing organizers[/u].[/p][p]See you soon![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update Note : Brazilian Portuguese for Demo
notes.content:
[h1][b]Olá![/b][/h1] 👋
We're happy to announce that our demo now supports Brazilian Portuguese!
If you're a Portuguese-speaking player, you can now experience the game in your own language — with all menus and in-game texts fully translated.

We hope this makes the game more accessible and enjoyable for even more players around the world.
Don't hesitate to share your feedback with us, and let us know if you spot any translation issues!

Obrigado e divirta-se! 🇧🇷


Patch Notes – Minor Update :
[list]
[*]     Added Brazilian Portuguese support 🇧🇷
[*]     Small fix on the loading screen display
[/list]

— The Dev Team

notes.title: Noir Total : Deadly Party — Live at Games Made In France!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We’re thrilled to announce that Noir Total : Deadly Party will be showcased live on Saturday the 17th on  [url=https://www.twitch.tv/mistermv]mistermv channel[/url] as part of the Games Made In France 2025 event!
The segment is scheduled for around 7:15 PM (CET) and the game will be presented by [url=https://www.twitch.tv/damdamlive]DamDamLive[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/ultia]Ultia[/url] !!

See you very soon!

notes.title: NOIR TOTAL : Deadly Party going to Indie Assemble !
notes.content:
Indie Assemble  event on Steam, scheduled from May 5 to May 11, 2025, organized by the Italian publisher [b]Excaliber[/b]. The initiative aims to spotlight independent video games, providing developers with a platform to enhance visibility and reach a broader audience. Coinciding with the Rome Video Game Lab, Indie Assemble offers an opportunity for indie developers to showcase their bestprojects !​

[b]Noir Total : Deadly Party[/b] has been [b]selected [/b]for the dedicated Steam promotion !

You can learn more about this cool event here : https://excaliber.it/en/ 

We will be back soon with other great news and announcement for the launch of the free demo !
